reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited compensation paragraphs (p0013–p0014) contain no most-favoured-nation, benchmarking, or price-matching obligation on the Customer — rates are set per Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, with only a Contractor-side rate-change right.
This matches the rule's preferred position ('No MFN obligation on Customer'), so the absence of any burdening MFN clause properly supports a compliant classification for this direction rule.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was proposed and no counterparty comment was added; the rendered text is identical to the original, which is the expected output.
Rationale is accurate and does not overstate: it notes the only pricing mechanic is Contractor's 30-day rate-change right, which is a separate issue and not mischaracterised as an MFN burden.
